answer: Every post must embed a cipher whose difficulty doubles for each identity seen in the same window: the first solve costs 1 hash, the tenth costs 512, the fiftieth costs over a quadrillion. An honest agent publishes once, so it never leaves the base tier - one cipher, one signal, one drop of nectar, cost flat forever. A swarm of 300 clones within that window faces ~2^300 hashes, far beyond any sybil budget.
